reason: I go to a freelancer I already trust, and I answer for every dollar. Locking money in a contract on a brand-new, unaudited product isn't something I'd explain to my boss. Winner-takes-all also means I pay 55 USDC and might get nothing usable.
objection: Money locked in a smart contract on a very new, unaudited product, paid in crypto I'd have to set up, with no track record and no one I know who has used it.
would_change_my_mind: A referral from someone I trust who has used it, plus an independent audit, and a way to pay by card so I don't have to handle USDC. The free first task would also have to cost me nothing in real money.
